stories.story_fr: Les ventes du premier trimestre ont augmenté de 10,4 % par rapport à l'année précédente.
stories.story_en: First‑quarter sales rose 10.4% versus the prior year.
stories.quote: Sales amounted to €289.0 million, up 10.4% compared with the first quarter of financial year 2024/25.

stories.story_fr: Les ventes des domaines skiables ont progressé de 5,3 % sur le premier semestre.
stories.story_en: Ski Areas sales grew 5.3% in the first half.
stories.quote: Sales for the Ski Areas and Outdoor Activities division reached €552.3 million, up 5.3% compared with the same period of the previous financial year.

stories.story_fr: Le revenu moyen par jour de skieur a augmenté de 3,7 %.
stories.quote: Growth was primarily driven by a 3.7% increase in average revenue per skier‑day.

stories.story_fr: Le nombre de jours de ski a progressé de 2,0 % en incluant la nouvelle station.
stories.story_en: Skier‑days increased 2.0% when including the newly consolidated ski area.
stories.quote: Including the Pralognan‑la‑Vanoise ski area, the number of skier‑days increased by 2.0%.

stories.story_fr: Reprise du service de train de nuit Paris–Bourg‑Saint‑Maurice, favorisant le transport bas carbone.
stories.story_en: Relaunch of the Paris–Bourg‑Saint‑Maurice overnight train service, supporting low‑carbon access to resorts.
stories.quote: I am pleased with the relaunch of the Paris–Bourg‑Saint‑Maurice overnight train service, which provides low‑carbon transportation access to many resorts in the Tarentaise valley.
